name: Venetian Arsenal industrial expansion
summary: Venice consolidates ship-construction at a single state-run complex on the eastern lagoon. By 1450 the Arsenal employs ~16,000 workers and can produce a fully-rigged galley in 24 hours using interchangeable parts and assembly-line construction, the largest pre-industrial manufactory in Europe.

_quarry.structural_significance: Underwrites Venetian naval dominance over Genoa (Chioggia War, 1378–81) and sustained galleys-of-Flanders trade rounds to northern Europe. Pre-figures Industrial-Revolution-era production methods by ~four centuries.
